name: anaconda_wrap_back
description: Green anaconda coils wrapped three times around an upright victim, split in two layers: draw anaconda_wrap_back, then the victim (Doug at scale 1 with hips on (0,0), a grey stick-man silhouette, or the library rat), then anaconda_wrap_front. Coils cover x -205..205, y -118..+150 (mid-chest to feet), so Doug's head, face, cap and shoulders stay visible above the top loop. Anchor = victim's hips (0,0), ~440x280. Same palette as green_anaconda. This layer: the loop parts BEHIND the body, the tail tip, and the head resting on the top coil at the right, facing left toward the victim's face, mouth closed.
